name: v2.30.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Show the user in the Docker prompt by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2371
* Bump astral-sh/setup-uv from 10.2.0 to 10.3.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2372
* Show the user in the prompt if a default user was used, instead of `(none)` by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2373
* Documentation: transforms are no longer experimental by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2374
* Update `cli_helpers` to v2.15.2, improving vertical output by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2375
* Populate Docker history file with examples by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2376
* Update `key_bindings.md`, syncing with web by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2377
* Orthography nit in `key_bindings.md` by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2378
* Update `ruff` dependency to v0.17.0 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2379
* Speed up `--list-dsn`, primarily on Python 3.15 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2380
* Complete moving `MyCli` to `client.py` by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2381
* Update changelog for release v2.30.0 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2382


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/compare/v2.29.6...v2.30.0
